description: HAVERHILL, Mass (Oct. 23, 2018) — Jim Fiorentini, the longest serving mayor of Haverhill, endorsed Lori Trahan, Democrat for Congress in the Third District, at a Tuesday night rally. The eight-term mayor said it is “vital that we keep a Democrat in this seat.” “Lori shares my priorities of providing affordable health care to all Americans […]
paid_for_by: Paid for by Lori Trahan for Congress
title: Representative Lori Trahan Congresswoman Lori Trahan was born and raised in a working-class family in Lowell, Massachusetts. She is the mom of two young girls and proudly represents Massachusetts' 3rd Congressional District.
